title: expr_scale
description: `expr_scale` scales an input value from one numeric range to another, with creation arguments specifying input low/high and output low/high values (for example, 0–9 to 100–255). The ranges can be changed dynamically with a `scale <in low> <in high> <out low> <out high>` message; the help patch notes that the object is unfinished and lacks a logarithmic factor.
